messages:
Priya S: FYI candidate Diego Ramos is visiting Mon 10:30am-2:00pm for SWE interview loop. A few items we need to lock down: hotel voucher night before, airport pickup / cab voucher, office badge + lobby escort, a note-taker for debrief, loaner MacBook (with local repo snapshot), and a labeled GF/vegan lunch. Also need a quiet spot for a short accessibility break. Can owners volunteer?

AJ Martin: I can take interviewer scheduling and the note-taker request. I'll add a 20m buffer after for panel sync.

Emily H: I can handle catering and the quiet room. Which room do you want? Quiet Room B (2nd floor) is low-traffic and has a small whiteboard.

Priya S: Quiet Room B works. Please add signage: "Private interview ". Also confirm lunch arrives at 12:15pm.

IT Support: Loaner MacBook available. Will image with macOS 12, Homebrew, VSCode, git. Do you need network access? We can include an offline snapshot or enable restricted Wi-Fi for the device. ETA: imaging Tue afternoon.

Priya S: Offline snapshot preferred. The exercise runs against a local repo snapshot and a small test server container. I'll DM the snapshot link to @IT Support. Please tag the laptop "Diego Ramos 1-Interview".

Facilities Bot: Visitor badge pre-approval requires full name + government ID last 4 digits + car plate if parking requested. Badge pickup available 30 mins before arrival.

Priya S: Got it. Diego provided last 4: 4321 and will request parking. I'll forward plate when I have it.

Nate L: I can arrange a cab voucher for airport pickup and hotel voucher for Sun night near the office. Please send me Diego's flight ETA and hotel preference (walking distance vs. shuttle).

Priya S: Flight ETA: Sun 8:15pm. Prefers walking distance. Nate, please book and share confirmation. Also please include receipts instructions for reimbursements.

people-ops-bot: Background check: cleared. Expense policy link: https://intranet.redwood/policy/expenses. Reminder: candidate-related reimbursements go through expense code HIRE-TRVL.

Emily H: Catering ordered: "GreenBox" GF/vegan boxed lunch, label with name. Delivery at 12:15 to Quiet Room B.

IT Support: Imaging script (internal):

```bash
# mac imaging snippet
jamf enroll --policy "interview-image-2025"
brew install --cask visual-studio-code docker
mkdir -p /Users/interview/repo-snapshot && tar -xzf /tmp/repo-snapshot.tar.gz -C /Users/interview/repo-snapshot
# set host-only network for the test container
```

AJ Martin: Note-taker: @AJ Martin will do the first panel, @Nate L will cover the second. Can interviewers annotate scorecards in Greenhouse within 24h?

Priya S: Yes please. Also request that anyone running a coding pair provides their laptop with VSCode Live Share enabled (or use the loaner).

Facilities Bot: Elevator access for guest floor granted. Escort scheduled at 10:00am from lobby. Parking pass granted for plate on file if received by 24h before.

Priya S: Sent Diego the travel confirmation email + asked for car plate. He confirmed dinner Sunday evening is fine for meetup with the hiring team (optional).

Nate L: Hotel booked: "Redwood Suites" confirmation 789102. Cab voucher sent. I'll upload receipts to share point.

IT Support: Imaging complete. Device staged and in bag labeled "Diego Ramos - Interview". I'll leave it on the table in Quiet Room B charged and plugged in.

Emily H: Signage printed and placed. Catering confirmed.

AJ Martin: All set on scheduling side. Added 20m debrief 2:00-2:20pm.

Priya S: Huge thanks everyone. I'll send a final pre-arrival checklist to Diego tonight and remind interviewers to complete scorecards. :pray:
